canned.cypher:
MATCH (a:Company)-[r:ACQUIRES]->(b:Company)
WHERE r.assertion IN ['hypothetical', 'forward_looking']
RETURN a.name, b.name, r.assertion, r.evidence

MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CEO_OF]->(c:Company)
WHERE (c.name = 'Northwind Logistics' OR 'Northwind' IN c.aliases)
  AND r.assertion = 'asserted'
RETURN p.name, c.name, r.evidence
canned.bare:
MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CEO_OF]->(c:Company)
WHERE c.name = 'Northwind'
RETURN p.name, c.name

canned.cypher:
MATCH (a:Company)-[r:COMPETES_WITH]->(b:Company)
WHERE r.assertion = 'asserted' AND r.supported >= 0.8
RETURN a.name, b.name, r.evidence

MATCH (c:Company)-[r:MAKES]->(p:Product)
WHERE (c.name = 'Halcyon Semiconductor Corporation' OR 'HLCN' IN c.aliases)
  AND r.assertion = 'asserted'
RETURN p.name

MATCH (c:Company)-[r:OPERATES_IN]->(i:Industry)
WHERE r.assertion = 'asserted'
RETURN c.name, i.name

MATCH (reg:Regulator)-[r:INVESTIGATES]->(c:Company)
RETURN reg.name, c.name, r.assertion, r.evidence

MATCH (reg:Regulator)-[r]->(c:Company)
WHERE r.assertion = 'negated'
RETURN reg.name, type(r), c.name, r.evidence

MATCH (p:Person)-[r:FOUNDED]->(c:Company)
WHERE r.assertion = 'asserted'
RETURN p.name, c.name, r.evidence

MATCH (a:Company)-[r:SUPPLIES]->(b:Company)
WHERE r.assertion = 'asserted' AND r.supported >= 0.8
RETURN a.name, b.name, r.evidence

MATCH (a:Company)-[r:PARTNERS_WITH]->(b:Company)
WHERE (a.name = 'Northwind Logistics' OR 'Northwind' IN a.aliases)
  AND r.assertion = 'asserted' AND r.supported >= 0.8
RETURN b.name, r.supported, r.evidence

MATCH (f:InvestmentFund)-[r:INVESTED_IN]->(c:Company)
WHERE r.assertion = 'asserted'
RETURN f.name, c.name, r.evidence

MATCH (a:Company)-[r:ACQUIRES]->(b:Company)
WHERE (a.name = 'Northwind Logistics' OR 'Northwind' IN a.aliases)
  AND r.assertion = 'asserted' AND r.supported >= 0.8
RETURN a.name, b.name, r.supported, r.evidence
